purpose: Archival-safety review of the 139 ARCHIVE-CANDIDATE repos from the 2026-07-09 shallow sweep. Each deep-checked for identity, successor, live references (grep across the whole mirror for owner/name + npm name), GitHub metadata (stars/forks/isArchived), and sync sanity. PROPOSE-ONLY: archiving is a human decision per magpie's hard rules; nothing here is actioned. Sorted SAFE-ARCHIVE (highest confidence first), then NEEDS-HUMAN, then KEEP.
